# vendor/

Third-party code, bundled unmodified so the extension needs no network access.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ort/ort.wasm.min.js` | onnxruntime-web (WASM build): runs the GLiNER ONNX model in the offscreen page |
| `ort/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs`, `ort/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm` | onnxruntime's SIMD, multi-threaded WebAssembly backend |
